content:
The TARIFF_BANK service uses billing slots 0, 30 and 60 logical minutes. An enrolment names account_id, plan and slot_minute; it may be lodged before or at that slot.

Only the latest pending enrolment for the account/slot becomes effective. The current plan persists absent another instruction.

Changing to a different plan charges its activation fee at effectiveness; keeping the same plan costs no second activation fee. Posted activation fees are not refundable on a later switch.

Each TARIFF_BANK commercial invoice requires one whole remittance, settles in 10 minutes and counts toward period volume at execution.
